<a2ui>
surface("list-surface")

// Initialize filter state
$/filterStatus = "all"

// Sample data
$/items = [
  {id: 1, title: "Project Alpha", status: "active", detail: "Launching next quarter with full team"},
  {id: 2, title: "Budget Review", status: "pending", detail: "Awaiting finance department approval"},
  {id: 3, title: "Client Onboarding", status: "active", detail: "Three new enterprise accounts in progress"},
  {id: 4, title: "Infrastructure Upgrade", status: "completed", detail: "Migration to cloud completed successfully"},
  {id: 5, title: "Security Audit", status: "pending", detail: "Third-party assessment scheduled for March"},
  {id: 6, title: "Team Training", status: "active", detail: "Quarterly skills development program underway"},
  {id: 7, title: "Documentation Update", status: "completed", detail: "API docs and guides published to portal"},
  {id: 8, title: "Performance Optimization", status: "pending", detail: "Database indexing strategy under review"}
]

root = body([
  heading("Items"),
  
  segmented_control(
    [
      {label: "All", value: "all"},
      {label: "Active", value: "active"},
      {label: "Pending", value: "pending"},
      {label: "Completed", value: "completed"}
    ],
    $/filterStatus,
    "statusFilter"
  ),
  
  entity_list(
    _template($/items, itemTemplate)
  )
])

itemTemplate = {
  name: $title,
  subtitle: $detail,
  status: statusBadge($status),
  icon: statusIcon($status)
}

statusBadge(status) = if(status == "active", 
  lozenge("Active", "inprogress"),
  if(status == "pending",
    lozenge("Pending", "moved"),
    lozenge("Completed", "success")
  )
)

statusIcon(status) = if(status == "active",
  "🟢",
  if(status == "pending",
    "🟡",
    "✅"
  )
)
</a2ui>
